none: PAS NLM-8095C2: Roman Coin: Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine, Trier mint, commemorative Constantinopolis issue, Reece period 17; RIC volume 7 no. 548, issue of 332-333. Obverse description: Constantinopolis helmeted laureate, mantled with reversed spear behind shoulder. Obverse inscription: CONSTAN TINOPOLIS. Reverse description: Victory standing left on prow with shield and spear. In exergue: TRS*. Diameter: 19.3mm, Weight:1.83gms, die axis: 12
